on:
  github:
    push:
      init:
        commit-sha: ${{ event.git.sha }}
        branch: ${{ event.git.branch }}
        repository: https://github.com/elviskahoro/reflex-starter-template.git
        event-type: push
        before-sha: ${{ event.github.push.before }}
      if: ${{ event.git.branch == 'main' || starts-with(event.git.branch, 'trunk-merge/') }}
      # merge.required_statuses (.trunk/trunk.yaml) must match status checks
      # that actually post. RWX's default per-run status is named after the
      # run definition and trigger ("RWX: trunk-check.yml (push)" vs
      # "(pull request)"), so it can never be required; the custom checks
      # below post stable names on PR heads and trunk-merge/** batch refs
      # alike. Task lists stay per-trigger: a task skipped on this trigger
      # reports its custom check as failed.
      status-checks:
        - tasks: [trunk-check-push]
          name: trunk-check
        - tasks: [tach-external]
          name: tach-external
    pull_request:
      init:
        commit-sha: ${{ event.git.sha }}
        repository: https://github.com/elviskahoro/reflex-starter-template.git
        event-type: pull_request
        base-sha: ${{ event.github.pull_request.pull_request.base.sha }}
      if: ${{ event.github.pull_request.pull_request.base.ref == 'main' }}
      # Same stable names as the push trigger above; the task list swaps in
      # trunk-check-pr, the variant that runs on pull requests.
      status-checks:
        - tasks: [trunk-check-pr]
          name: trunk-check
        - tasks: [tach-external]
          name: tach-external
  cli:
    init:
      commit-sha: ${{ event.git.sha }}
      branch: ${{ event.git.branch }}
      repository: https://github.com/elviskahoro/reflex-starter-template.git
      event-type: push
      before-sha: ""

base:
  image: ubuntu:24.04
  config: rwx/base 1.2.0

tasks:
  - key: code
    call: git/clone 2.2.0
    with:
      repository: ${{ init.repository }}
      ref: ${{ init.commit-sha }}
      fetch-full-depth: true
      preserve-git-dir: true

  - key: uv-install
    run: |
      set -euo pipefail
      script="$(mktemp)"
      trap 'rm -f "${script}"' EXIT
      curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/0.11.13/install.sh -o "${script}"
      echo "48cd5aca5d5671a3b3d5f61538cc8622e4434af63319115159990d8b0dd02416  ${script}" | sha256sum -c -
      sh "${script}"
      echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> $RWX_ENV/PATH

  - key: deps
    use: [code, uv-install]
    filter:
      - pyproject.toml
      - uv.lock
    run: |
      uv sync --frozen --group dev
      echo "$PWD/.venv/bin" >> $RWX_ENV/PATH
      echo "VIRTUAL_ENV=$PWD/.venv" >> $RWX_ENV/VIRTUAL_ENV

  - key: trunk-install
    run: |
      set -euo pipefail
      trunk_version="1.25.0"
      if [[ "$(uname -m)" != "x86_64" ]]; then
        echo "error: pinned Trunk CLI archive requires x86_64" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      trunk_archive="$(mktemp)"
      trunk_extract="$(mktemp -d)"
      trap 'rm -f "${trunk_archive}"; rm -rf "${trunk_extract}"' EXIT
      curl -fsSL "https://trunk.io/releases/${trunk_version}/trunk-${trunk_version}-linux-x86_64.tar.gz" -o "${trunk_archive}"
      echo "3845ff76a70cebb10e61a267ff719ffdccfa3ef6d877d51870a2c62b79603ab9  ${trunk_archive}" | sha256sum -c -
      tar -C "${trunk_extract}" -xzf "${trunk_archive}"
      trunk_binary="$(find "${trunk_extract}" -type f -name trunk -perm -u+x -print -quit)"
      if [[ -z "${trunk_binary}" ]]; then
        echo "error: Trunk CLI archive contains no executable trunk binary" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
      install -m 755 "${trunk_binary}" "$HOME/.local/bin/trunk"
      echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> $RWX_ENV/PATH
      trunk_version_output="$("$HOME/.local/bin/trunk" --version)"
      if [[ "${trunk_version_output}" != *"${trunk_version}"* ]]; then
        echo "error: installed Trunk CLI did not report version ${trunk_version}" >&2
        exit 1
      fi

  # Tool cache: every linter/plugin pin in trunk.yaml is downloaded once and
  # reused until .trunk/ changes. The filter only scopes the task defining it,
  # so trunk-config and trunk-tools both declare it; keep them in lockstep.
  - key: trunk-config
    use: [code]
    filter:
      - .trunk/trunk.yaml
    run: |
      set -euo pipefail
      mkdir -p "$HOME/trunk-seed"
      cp -r .trunk "$HOME/trunk-seed/.trunk"
      rm -rf "$HOME/trunk-seed/.trunk/.gitignore"
      cd "$HOME/trunk-seed"
      git init -q
      # Pinned dates keep the seed commit byte-identical across cold re-runs,
      # so the downstream cache key does not bust on wall-clock timestamps.
      export GIT_AUTHOR_DATE="2000-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"
      export GIT_COMMITTER_DATE="2000-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"
      git -c user.name=rwx -c user.email=rwx@example.com commit -q --allow-empty -m seed

  - key: trunk-tools
    use: [trunk-install, trunk-config]
    filter:
      - .trunk/trunk.yaml
    run: |
      set -euo pipefail
      cd "$HOME/trunk-seed"
      trunk install --ci < /dev/null

  # tach's external-dependency audit cannot be a Trunk lint command: Trunk
  # runs batch commands from a sandbox holding only the diff's files, so every
  # dependency imported outside the diff is falsely reported unused.
  - key: tach-external
    use: [code, deps]
    run: uv run tach check-external

  - key: trunk-check-pr
    use: [code, trunk-tools, deps]
    if: ${{ init.event-type == 'pull_request' }}
    run: |
      set -euo pipefail
      trunk check --upstream="${BASE_SHA}" --ci < /dev/null
    env:
      BASE_SHA: ${{ init.base-sha }}

  - key: trunk-check-push
    use: [code, trunk-tools, deps]
    if: ${{ init.event-type == 'push' }}
    run: |
      set -euo pipefail
      trunk check --all --ci < /dev/null

I removed the nightly Trunk check from `.rwx/smoke-nightly.yml`. I deleted the `trunk-check-all` task and the `trunk-install` task that only it used. I didn't run anything or commit, so the change is uncommitted in the working tree.

The nightly still runs `pytest` and `reflex-export`. Nothing else references `trunk-check-all`.

Trunk now runs on PRs, and on pushes to `main` and `trunk-merge/` branches, all from `.rwx/trunk-check.yml`. The nightly run was the only one that would catch a linter or plugin update breaking things on a day with no commits. Trunk's pinned tool versions keep that risk low, and the `trunk-upgrade-available` action in `.trunk/trunk.yaml` is still enabled.
